name: Maps
description: A map of every place your room has: the places you have saved and the items other modules put somewhere. Pick a spot to save a new place.
author: Coffee Pub

permissions.label: See the map and its places
Save places from the map and put items on it

settings.label: Map file
settings.help: A PMTiles map file (a region or the world) in the map-tiles folder inside the Maps module folder (modules/maps/map-tiles/ in the data folder). Nothing shows until one is chosen.

settings.label: Search address
settings.help: Optional. The address of a Photon-compatible place search that you run or may use, over https (for example https://search.example.org/api). Leave it empty for a map without search.
